steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ as admin (skipped the change-password screen), then opened the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" via the search/command palette. The dashboard renders exactly 3 panels: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

Created a new Grafana dashboard titled "fwgr67-n2 Bench Dashboard" containing one Stat panel titled "fwgr67-n2 Availability" wired to the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), then saved it via Save dashboard (the save drawer's title field was set to the required name and the Save button confirmed). The save is verified: the URL changed to the app-assigned dashboard uid and, after a full page reload, the breadcrumb still reads "fwgr67-n2 Bench Dashboard" with the panel headed "fwgr67-n2 Availability" rendering a live value.

On dashboard 'fwgr67-n2 Bench Dashboard' (uid afz0rzm0uvpc0c) I entered edit mode, added a new panel, switched its visualization to Text, set its title to 'fwgr67-n2 Notes' and its markdown content to 'Notes for run fwgr67-n2', then saved via Save dashboard (drawer confirmed with Save). After editing I hit Back to dashboard and performed a full page reload: both panels are present in the reloaded DOM — a Text panel headed 'fwgr67-n2 Notes' rendering the paragraph 'Notes for run fwgr67-n2', and the Stat panel 'fwgr67-n2 Availability' showing a live value (59.5). Save is therefore confirmed as persisted.
